name: BACH_0275
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged (tier 2) for invasive risk [F1]; confirm invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 stain orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Single dominant class probability |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target coverage (test 90%) | Excludes other classes at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 86% OOD (12/12 regions kept) [F6] | Typical input, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (87%–89%); contrast InSitu (82%) [F5] | Neighbors match; InSitu contrast close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical stromal infiltration score (+2.02 contribution; 19/20 AI spot-checked) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical tubule score pushes toward invasive (+0.79; 18/20 spot-checked) [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.70), but concept is unreliable (0/20 AI spot-checked) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Elevated nuclear atypia embedding score (+0.56 contribution; 18/20 AI spot-checked) · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 3, 8) · context · 90th percentile nuclear size variation (63 neoplastic nuclei in region 3) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops risk more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); ignore unreliable normal lobules, mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Apparent stromal infiltration is high-grade in situ carcinoma, like contrast case BACH_0155 (InSitu, 82% similarity) with weak duct-confinement scoring.
- Low nuclear shape variation (8th percentile [F8]) and 86% OOD reflect morphology underrepresented in the 24-patient test set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Confirm true stromal invasion rather than in situ carcinoma; region 3 has 63 neoplastic nuclei.
2. **Regions 4, 6, 8**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism and size variation before signing out or ordering ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67.
3. **Regions 5, 9**: Inspect lower-risk zones (97%, 87%) for residual tubules, benign stroma, or in situ boundaries.
